name: EA-18G Growler
variants: EA-18G with Next Generation Jammer pods
summary: Two-seat electronic-attack version of the F/A-18F Super Hornet, flown by Navy carrier and expeditionary squadrons to jam and destroy enemy air defenses.

wings: Super Hornet wing with dogtooth leading edge and large LERX
Bulbous receiver pods at the wingtips instead of missile rails
Large jamming pods on underwing and centerline pylons
engines: Two engines with round exhausts side by side
Rectangular caret-style intakes under the LERX
fuselage: Two-seat tandem cockpit under a long canopy
Small blade antennas along the spine and behind the cockpit
Jamming pods have a small propeller turbine at the front (older pods) or a smooth angular shape (newer pods)

tellTales: Fat pods on the wingtips instead of missiles
Big jamming pods with little nose propellers hung under the wings
Two-seat canopy on a twin-fin carrier jet

confusedWith.howToTell: The Growler has bulbous wingtip pods and big jamming pods; the Super Hornet carries missiles on its wingtips and fuel tanks or weapons underneath.
The Growler is the larger Super Hornet airframe with rectangular intakes, wingtip pods and two seats; the legacy Hornet has rounded intakes and wingtip missiles.

usCount.source: FlightGlobal World Air Forces 2026 / US Navy fact file
